name: mediasense.precheck.read
description: 读取确切不可变 Result：review 共同交付材料路径、自身关联属性和压缩关系；可选读已准备 Evidence。不获取新证据，不强制看图。

evidence_refs.description: Omit for the sealed entry order; otherwise select prepared Evidence in sorted reference order. No acquisition.

threshold.description: Effective nonnegative cutoff, not a probability. Values above 1 preserve profiles whose labels cannot trigger this comparison.

mild_threshold.description: Effective nonnegative mild cutoff, not a probability. Preserve the recorded value, including values above 1.

value.description: Preserve recorded verification fields and their actual strength. Legacy missing fields stay unknown; resolve uses the existing source_verification projection.

review_item_failure.description: A local read failure occupies this Evidence's position in the same page. It is not successful evidence delivery and does not change the sealed Result.

$comment: Development authority at docs/spec/contract/precheck-read. Runtime release snapshots are synchronized only with milestone-two implementation. No old/new public routing.
